newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle not tested - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle not tested - USDA.

text.p: Trade was inactive in the Panhandle area Monday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers were not tested. Feedlots reporting moderate inquiry.
There were 23,700 sales confirmed for the week to date which includes 22,000 head formulated and 300 head previously contracted cattle to be shipped this week.
The last established price was $64.00 per cwt on Friday. Tuesday's packer bids were mostly $63.00, with asking prices $65.00-$66.00.
Confirmed - None Week Ago - None Year Ago - None
Wk to Date - 23,700 Week Ago - 1,700 Year Ago - 6,800
